note: Every card and Crown Project. "final" entries have a clear-line illustration in public/cards, drawn from code in scripts/art; none are generated paintings. "svg" would mean a card still shows its inline scene from src/games/clockwork/ui/art.ts.
style: Minimalist medieval editorial illustration: soft flat shapes, burgundy, antique gold, warm ivory and charcoal with muted natural colours. People without detailed faces, inhabited places, no text, no machinery, 16:9, readable when small.
